schema:
CREATE TABLE employee (
  address,
  city,
  employee_id,
  first_name,
  last_name,
  phone,
  salary,
  state,
  supervisor,
  title,
  zip
);

CREATE TABLE establishment (
  address,
  aka_name,
  city,
  dba_name,
  facility_type,
  latitude,
  license_no,
  longitude,
  risk_level,
  state,
  ward,
  zip
);

CREATE TABLE inspection (
  employee_id,
  followup_to,
  inspection_date,
  inspection_id,
  inspection_type,
  license_no,
  results
);

CREATE TABLE inspection_point (
  Description,
  category,
  code,
  fine,
  point_id,
  point_level
);
